template.content:
# Intake and Authority Context

1. Authority map: established authority order and authoritative source identities
2. Initial Project Context Profile
3. Facts and repository evidence
4. Conflicts
5. Classified unknowns with owner, impact, required evidence and return location

questions: Which authorities were scanned, and which facts were derived rather than asked?
sections.completionCondition: Derivable facts were investigated rather than converted into user questions.

questions: Does every fixed topic/subtopic have an explicit status?
Are all design-significant derivable facts resolved?
Does no USER_DECISION_REQUIRED or BLOCKED item remain?
sections.completionCondition: Every fixed topic/subtopic has an explicit status; non-blocking DERIVABLE, DESIGN_EXPLORATION, TO_BE_MEASURED and DEFERRED items have owner, blocks, evidence and return location; the user explicitly confirmed the whole Brief.
sections.naRule: A topic may be reasoned NOT_APPLICABLE only with a project-specific reason.

questions: Does each Module hide meaningful complexity?
Does every required scenario have an architectural path?
Do quality scenarios shape the direction?
sections.completionCondition: Architecture direction and technical feasibility are closed; no required scenario lacks an architectural path.

questions: Are terminology, human-first reading order, IDs, diagram/text parity, ownership and traceability consistent?
Is there one branch-free successful core before named exception scenarios?
sections.completionCondition: The versioned complete Draft is coherent, self-contained and suitable for independent review; no template placeholder remains.

questions: Is the final Design understandable without a deleted treatment, review transcript, question set, validator report or freeze manifest?
Are all durable decisions, accepted risks, open work, acceptance mappings, downstream obligations and runtime-tuning handoffs represented?
sections.completionCondition: The final Design is bound to exact Git/artifact identity, not stale, and requires no session artifact to be understood or implemented.
sections.naRule: No session artifact may be a required reference.

questions: Which requesting Action or Finding discovered the gap?
Why does this belong to research and not user decision?
What is the recorded resume_action and resume_lens?
sections.completionCondition: The request records one derivable factual question, authority scope, prior evidence, required result, resume_action (SD-05 | SD-09) and exact resume_lens when returning to SD-09.

template.content:
# Evidence Research Result

1. Sources and observations
2. Conflicts
3. Confidence and uncertainty reason
4. Resolved/unresolved state
5. Return binding: recorded resume_action and resume_lens (unchanged by the Scout)

questions: Does the result return only to the recorded requester (SD-05 or the affected SD-09 lens)?
sections.completionCondition: The Evidence Scout did not change the recorded resume_action or resume_lens.
sections.naRule: resume_lens applies only when returning to SD-09.

questions: Does the request bind the exact question, environment, method and evidence requirements?
sections.completionCondition: The Spike Request carries an exact request identity and content digest; class is architecture-feasibility or design-owned-parameter.
sections.naRule: Implementation feasibility, implementation verification, Contract publication and runtime tuning are downstream obligations, not SD-06/SD-12 Spike classes.

questions: Does the result bind the exact request identity and content digest?
Are executor environment, method and evidence comparable with the request contract?
sections.completionCondition: Only a result whose request, environment, method and evidence satisfy the request contract may close the Spike; status is CONCLUSIVE, INCONCLUSIVE or INVALID.
sections.naRule: A later downstream result is compared with its recorded design-reopen condition; it never retroactively becomes a System Design completion prerequisite.

questions: Does the request contain one exact decision?
Is available evidence exhausted and can at least two directions not simultaneously hold?
Is the human the correct owner and is the complete Decision Packet present?
sections.completionCondition: All six Human Decision Admission conditions hold: one exact decision, evidence exhausted, at least two directions cannot simultaneously hold, the choice materially changes boundary/responsibility/quality target/architecture, the human is the correct owner, and a complete Decision Packet (claims, evidence, prior investigation, options, consequences, recommendation, affected identities, return Action) is present.
sections.naRule: Ordinary initial/local grilling and explicit Brief confirmation are planned collaboration, not conflict escalation.

questions: Was the decision confirmed explicitly by the human owner after questions and new options were allowed?
sections.completionCondition: An explicit Human Decision Record exists; exploratory replies were never interpreted as decisions.
sections.naRule: No record may be frozen from a question or exploratory statement.

template.content:
# Review Finding

1. finding_id (stable)
2. lens (PROBLEM_SOLUTION | ARCHITECTURE | QUALITY_ACCEPTANCE | FRESH_READER)
3. draft_binding (exact content digest reviewed)
4. location (design identity/section/diagram)
5. observation (exact statement, omission or contradiction)
6. applicable_requirement (Brief/project/design authority identity)
7. evidence
8. project_impact (concrete impact in the confirmed context)
9. resolution_direction (bounded recommendation, not an edit)
10. severity (BLOCKING | MAJOR | MINOR)
11. confidence and uncertainty reason
12. status (OPEN | CLOSED_FIXED | CLOSED_NOT_VALID | ACCEPTED_MINOR)
13. provenance (Reviewer route/session/result identity)

A REVIEW_SIGNAL records location, observed signal, investigation performed and why admission evidence is currently insufficient; it is not a Finding, cannot block, cannot trigger Human Decision, and must not be counted as reported risk.

questions: Does the Finding carry exact location, observation, applicable requirement, evidence, concrete impact, project-specific relevance, resolution direction, severity and confidence?
sections.completionCondition: Severity/disposition is decided by the source lens; the Aggregator and Designer may propose disposition but cannot apply it; only the corresponding review lens can close a Finding in a fresh session against the original Finding, treatment, new Draft and evidence.
sections.naRule: N/A only when no Finding was admitted; REVIEW_SIGNALs are never admitted as Findings.

template.content:
# Revision Request

1. revision_id (stable)
2. origin_type (REVIEW_FINDING | FRESH_READER_FINDING | SPIKE_RESULT | HUMAN_DECISION | DETERMINISTIC_FAILURE)
3. origin_identity (exact Finding/result/check identity)
4. draft_binding (exact artifact to revise)
5. affected_identities (sections/diagrams/decisions/acceptance relations affected)
6. required_change (bounded correction without inventing new authority)
7. invalidated_reviews (review/reader evidence invalidated by the change)
8. return_action (SD-09 | SD-13 | SD-14, selected from the invalidated validation evidence)
9. evidence (why the revision is required)

questions: Is return_action consistent with the origin type and the invalidated validation evidence?
sections.completionCondition: Runtime validates return_action against origin and invalidation state; SD-11 may not default every request to SD-09; non-Finding corrections retain their origin identity without an artificial Review Finding.
sections.naRule: A validator failure is never wrapped in an artificial Review Finding.

template.content:
# Aggregation and Triage Result

1. Merged Findings with preserved provenance (common causes merged, origin lens identities intact)
2. Identified contradictions
3. Routing decision (evidence-gap | brief-gap | conflict | skeleton-invalid | draft-fix | disposition-valid)
4. No majority decision; no hidden risk; no inflated signals; no severity change without the source Reviewer; no Finding closed

questions: Were corroborating Findings merged while preserving provenance, and was routing chosen by evidence and affected stage?
sections.completionCondition: The aggregation result preserves provenance and routes within the declared successor set.
sections.naRule: N/A only when no Finding was admitted.

template.content:
# Fresh Reader Question Set

1. question_set_id and design_binding (exact candidate Design content digest)
2. Per question: question_id, source_identities (Brief/template), question, expected_elements, prohibited_context
3. Coverage: problem, decomposition, collaboration, ownership, constraints, quality mechanisms, parameter lifecycle, acceptance
4. At least one question requires a correct explanation without stable IDs followed by successful ID lookup
5. Prohibited context: author/grilling/review context the reader must not receive

questions: Can a downstream implementer reconstruct the design from the Design alone?
sections.completionCondition: The question set tests comprehension of problem, decomposition, flows, ownership, constraints, quality mechanisms, parameter status and acceptance; it does not test architecture preference.
